newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Pasaraya likely to list in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Pasaraya likely to list in 1997.

text.p: Indonesian departement store operator PT Pasaraya Nusakarya is likely to float shares after parliamentary elections in mid-1997, company sources said on Tuesday.
"We will stick to our original plan to float shares but we are still discussing the timetable as we are concerned about recent conditions on the bourse," said one senior company official.
"The company prefers to wait until the general election is completed as we believe the bourse will then be in a stable condition," he added.
Pasaraya previously planned to float 151.4 million shares, or 35 percent of its total equity, in July.

Officials at ALatief Corporations - the holding company of Pasaraya Nusakarya - ascribed the delay to unstable conditions on the market following worries over President Suharto's health and political unrest.
Pasaraya currently operates three department stores in Jakarta. The company's president director Usman Ja'far told Reuters on Tuesday that one of the department stores will be expanded next year.
